dialogue.content: お越しいただきありがとうございます。準備が出来ましたら始めさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming. We can begin whenever you’re ready.

dialogue.content: こんばんわ。宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: 準備オッケーです
dialogue.English: I'm ready.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。ありがとうございます。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: 相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm the counselor. How can I help you today?

dialogue.content: 好きな人が居るのですが、家族に反対されていて、どうしたらいいのか悩んでます
dialogue.English: I have someone I love, but my family is against the relationship, and I’m struggling with what to do.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。よろしければ年令と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see. If you don't mind, could you tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 2５歳　女です
dialogue.English: I’m a 25-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。何とお呼びすればよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What should I call you?

dialogue.content: ゆき　です
dialogue.English: Yuki.

dialogue.content: ゆきさんですね。良ければもう少し詳しく教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Yuki, is that right? If you're comfortable, could you tell me a little more about your situation?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 家族は私に家を継いで欲しいのですが、暴言を吐く父が嫌いで家を出て、そこで彼と出会いました
dialogue.English: My family wants me to take over for the family, but I couldn't stand my verbally abusive father, so I left home. That's when I met him.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 私に彼が居ると知り、
dialogue.English: When they found out I had a boyfriend,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 父は激怒。直ぐに帰って来いと、、
dialogue.English: My father was furious and told me to come home immediately…

dialogue.content: そうなのですね...
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: そこで母も姉も交際に反対で、味方は居ません
dialogue.English: And now my mother and older sister are also against the relationship, so I have no one on my side.

dialogue.content: 悩んでます
dialogue.English: I'm really struggling.

dialogue.content: それはゆきさんにとってとてもお辛いですね...
dialogue.English: That must be very painful for you, Yuki…

dialogue.content: お父様は
dialogue.English: Your father…

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 家を継いでほしいとのことですが
dialogue.English: You mentioned he wants you to take over the family,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ゆきさんは長女でいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Are you the eldest daughter, Yuki?

dialogue.content: いえ、姉が居ます
dialogue.English: No, I have an older sister.

dialogue.content: お父様がゆきさんに継いでほしいという理由があるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is there a reason why your father wants you specifically to take over?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: よろしければ理由を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: If you don't mind, could you tell me the reason?

dialogue.content: 姉と父は似たもの同士で、直ぐに喧嘩になります。さらに姉は病気で子が産めません。
dialogue.English: My sister and father are very similar and they fight all the time. On top of that, my sister can't have children due to an illness.

dialogue.content: だから、子が産める私に後を継いで欲しいと、母から聞きました
dialogue.English: So, my mother told me that they want me, the one who can have children, to take over for the family.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね...
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ゆきさんにとっては深刻なことですね...
dialogue.English: This is a very serious matter for you, Yuki…

dialogue.content: はい、とても深刻です。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's very serious.

dialogue.content: ゆきさんの好きな方はそのことをご存知なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does the person you love know about this situation?

dialogue.content: はい、すべて知ってます
dialogue.English: Yes, he knows everything.

dialogue.content: 彼は何とおっしゃっていますか？
dialogue.English: What has he said about it?

dialogue.content: 悩んでいました。私にそばに居て欲しいと思ってはいるのですが、私が悲しむのは見たくないと・・
dialogue.English: He was conflicted. He wants me to be with him, but he doesn't want to see me in pain…

dialogue.content: 彼も複雑な気持ちを抱えていらっしゃるのですね...
dialogue.English: So he has complex feelings about it as well...

dialogue.content: はい、私が悩み、苦しむので、、
dialogue.English: Yes, because I'm struggling and in pain…

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: どうしたら泣かずに解決できるかを
dialogue.English: about how we could resolve this without tears…

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 考えてはくれていましたが、
dialogue.English: He had been thinking about it, but…

dialogue.content: 最後は自分で決めて欲しい、みたいな感じです。
dialogue.English: In the end, it feels like he wants me to decide for myself.

dialogue.content: 母が、、
dialogue.English: My mother…

dialogue.content: 彼は自分のことよりもゆきさんのことを思っていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like he's thinking of you more than himself.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: お母様が最後は自分で決めてほしいとゆきさんに伝えられたのですか？
dialogue.English: Was it your mother who told you that, in the end, she wants you to decide for yourself?

dialogue.content: 彼は、はい、そう感じました。いえ、違います母は、父に暴言を受けて、精神的に参ってしまい、私に助けを求めてるのが分かるんです。
dialogue.English: As for him, yes, that’s how I felt. No, that’s not it—my mother has been verbally abused by my father and is mentally exhausted, and I can tell she’s seeking help from me.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね...
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 母は、子の産めない体の
dialogue.English: My mother, because her daughter can't have children,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 長女を生んだことも責めています
dialogue.English: she blames herself for giving birth to her eldest daughter.

dialogue.content: だから、姉も母も父も私を頼ってる
dialogue.English: That's why my sister, my mother, and my father are all depending on me.

dialogue.content: お母様も辛い思いを抱えているのですね...
dialogue.English: Your mother is carrying a heavy burden as well...

dialogue.content: けれど
dialogue.English: But…

dialogue.content: はい、自分を責めてます
dialogue.English: Yes, she's blaming herself.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一番辛い思いをされているのはゆきさんだと思います。
dialogue.English: I think the person who is suffering the most is you, Yuki.

dialogue.content: ええ！そうなんですか？
dialogue.English: Oh! Do you really think so?

dialogue.content: 家族のみなさんがゆきさんに
dialogue.English: Your whole family...

dialogue.content: 継いでもらうことを望まれて
dialogue.English: is hoping you will take over,

dialogue.content: ゆきさんも家族と彼のどちらも大切で辛さを抱えているのではと感じました。
dialogue.English: and I sense that you're in a painful position because both your family and your boyfriend are important to you.

dialogue.content: はい、そうです。どちらかを選ばないといけないのはキツイです
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right. Having to choose one or the other is really tough.

dialogue.content: そうですよね...
dialogue.English: It is, isn’t it…

dialogue.content: ゆきさんは
dialogue.English: Yuki, do you...

dialogue.content: 継ぐことに抵抗はあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: have any resistance to the idea of taking over?

dialogue.content: 抵抗あります。嫌なのです。
dialogue.English: I do. I don’t want to.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね...
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: はい、継がなくてもいいから、
dialogue.English: Yes... she said I don't have to take over, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 近くの人と結婚して住んで、子を見せてやって欲しいと、自分にはそれが出来ないから姉に泣きながら土下座されました。
dialogue.English: my sister got on her knees, crying, and begged me to marry someone from nearby, live here, and let them see my children, because she can't do it herself.

dialogue.content: 姉は、
dialogue.English: My sister…

dialogue.content: 病気で子が産めない体になったとき
dialogue.English: When she became unable to have children due to her illness,

dialogue.content: 泣きながら土下座されることは胸が痛みますね...
dialogue.English: It must be heartbreaking to have her kneel and beg you in tears…

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 姉と親元を離れ一緒に暮らしてたんです
dialogue.English: My sister and I used to live together, away from our parents.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね...
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 病気で手術して、姉が死にたいほど苦しんだ姿を
dialogue.English: I saw how, because of her illness and surgery, my sister suffered to the point of wanting to die,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 見ていたもので、
dialogue.English: and having witnessed that,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 姉の土下座は、彼と別れる気持ちに今傾きつつ
dialogue.English: after my sister begged me like that, I've been leaning towards breaking up with him,

dialogue.content: ここにきました
dialogue.English: and that's why I came here.

dialogue.content: ゆきさんはとても辛い気持ちを抱えていたことをお話し下さったのですね...
dialogue.English: It sounds like you've been carrying such painful feelings. Thank you for sharing that with me...

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 聞かせていただき私自身、胸が締め付けられます...
dialogue.English: Hearing your story, I feel a tightness in my own chest...

dialogue.content: 彼は
dialogue.English: Your boyfriend,

dialogue.content: ゆきさんのご実家の
dialogue.English: near your family home...

dialogue.content: 近くに一緒に住むことは難しいのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be difficult for you to live together with him?

dialogue.content: その話もでました
dialogue.English: We talked about that as well.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね
dialogue.English: You did?

dialogue.content: というか、私がしました
dialogue.English: Or rather, I brought it up.

dialogue.content: ご家族は何とおっしゃっていましたか？
dialogue.English: What did your family say?

dialogue.content: 彼は父が早くに他界したので、母と自分の二人暮らし
dialogue.English: His father passed away early, so it's just him and his mother.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: お嫁さんが来るのをとても楽しみにしている
dialogue.English: She is very much looking forward to having a daughter-in-law.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね...
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: だから、厳しいと。
dialogue.English: So, he said it would be difficult.

dialogue.content: ゆきさんも彼も
dialogue.English: So both you and he...

dialogue.content: ご家族の思いを受けているのですね...
dialogue.English: are carrying the weight of your families' expectations...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: とても複雑なことだと思うので、ゆきさんと彼が
dialogue.English: I think this is a very complicated situation, so for you and him...

dialogue.content: 幸せになれる方法を一つ一つ、一緒に考えさせていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I'd like to help you think through, one step at a time, how you and your boyfriend can find a way to be happy together. Would that be alright?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: ゆきさんの思いはこういう形に出来たらいいなということはありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there an ideal way you wish this could turn out?

dialogue.content: 母が精神疾患なので、それがなかったら
dialogue.English: My mother has a mental illness, so if that weren’t the case,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 父に何とか、と思うのですが
dialogue.English: I think I could somehow deal with my father, but…

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 父は彼の話を聴きもしてくれません
dialogue.English: My father won’t even hear him out.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね...
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 父は弱い人で
dialogue.English: My father is a weak person,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 大声出して怒鳴って威圧したらいいと思ってる。彼にそんな父に合わせるのも怖いです
dialogue.English: He thinks he can just intimidate people by yelling and shouting. I'm scared to make my boyfriend meet a father like that.

dialogue.content: そうですよね...
dialogue.English: I can understand that…

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まずはお父様とお母様の
dialogue.English: First, about your father and mother...

dialogue.content: 気持ちが安らいでもらえることが出来たらと思いました。
dialogue.English: I was thinking it would be good if we could find a way for them to feel more at ease.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、執着するところが、何故私？って思います
dialogue.English: You're right. Their fixation on this... it makes me wonder, 'Why me?'

dialogue.content: お父様とお母様にとって
dialogue.English: For your father and mother,

dialogue.content: 健康で子を生んでもらえるゆきさんが希望なのでは...と感じます。
dialogue.English: I get the sense that you, being healthy and able to have children, represent hope for them.

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです。姉の病気は、二人にとって相当ショックだったみたいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's it. My sister's illness seems to have been a huge shock to both of them.

dialogue.content: だから
dialogue.English: That's why,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 姉には少しでも自由に生かせてやりたい、みたいなのを感じます
dialogue.English: I feel like they want to let my sister live as freely as possible.

dialogue.content: 親の気持ちというものもあると思います。けれどそれでゆきさんの
dialogue.English: I think there are the parents’ feelings to consider. But for that to affect your...

dialogue.content: 人生に関わってくることもやりきれないですよね...
dialogue.English: life must be unbearable...

dialogue.content: はい。私の相手なんて時が来れば誰でも同じとか、愛とか好きとか初めだけって父母は言います
dialogue.English: Yes. My parents say that when the time comes, anyone would be the same for me, and that feelings like 'love' and 'like' are only there at the beginning.

dialogue.content: 両親が近くに居て、出産後とか手伝ってもらったり
dialogue.English: They say that having parents nearby to help after childbirth,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: しないと、私が苦労するって
dialogue.English: is necessary, or else I'll be the one who suffers.

dialogue.content: 私が帰ってこないんじゃないかって思っています
dialogue.English: They think I might not come back home.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね...
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どっちが後悔するかを考えたんです
dialogue.English: I thought about which choice I'd regret more.

dialogue.content: お父様とお母様の気持ちの中にとても苦しい思いをしてきたことを感じます...
dialogue.English: I sense that your parents have been through a lot of emotional pain…

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: もう、自分の気持ちはどこにも入らず、単純に3対１だなって、
dialogue.English: My own feelings don't even factor in anymore. It's simply three against one,

dialogue.content: 3人も悲しませられないなって
dialogue.English: and I feel like I can’t make three people sad.

dialogue.content: そう思ってしまうのも無理はないと思います...
dialogue.English: It’s understandable that you would feel that way…

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まずはどんな形からでも良いのでご家族で話し合うことが出来たらよいと思うのですが
dialogue.English: First, I think it would be good if you could talk with your family, in any way possible,

dialogue.content: 難しそうですか？
dialogue.English: does that seem difficult?

dialogue.content: 普通に反対されてるだけなら、まだしも、
dialogue.English: If it were just ordinary opposition, that would be one thing, but…

dialogue.content: ちょっと、この今の状況から早く楽になりたいばかりですね
dialogue.English: Right now, I just want to be free from this situation as soon as possible.

dialogue.content: そうですよね...ゆきさんの心を少しでも軽く出来ることを考えたいと思います。
dialogue.English: I understand... I want to think of a way to lighten the burden on your heart, even just a little.

dialogue.content: 姉か母か一人でも賛成してくれたらって思います
dialogue.English: I wish even one of them—my sister or my mother—would support me.

dialogue.content: そうですね！まずは一人づつ話してみるのはどうでしょう？
dialogue.English: Yes! How about trying to talk to them one by one?

dialogue.content: そうですね、今は厳しいですが、
dialogue.English: You're right. It's difficult right now, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 私がどこまで耐えられるかな、、。
dialogue.English: I wonder how much longer I can endure this...

dialogue.content: ですが。
dialogue.English: But…

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。今は先行き不安ですが
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'm anxious about the future, but...

dialogue.content: もう少し頑張ってみます
dialogue.English: I’ll try to hang in there a little longer.

dialogue.content: ゆきさんの気持ちが辛い中でまだ解決策に繋がらなく心苦しいです...
dialogue.English: It pains me that we haven't found a solution yet while you're feeling so distressed...

dialogue.content: いえいえ、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: No, not at all—thank you.

dialogue.content: よかったらゆきさんのお話しをまたお聞かせ下さい。
dialogue.English: If you'd like, please come and talk to me again.

dialogue.content: はい、是非、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'd like that very much. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ゆきさんの気持ちが少しでも軽くなることを願っています。
dialogue.English: I hope you feel even a little bit lighter.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: 失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Goodbye for now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.
